papers.title_en: Learning from Reliable Latent Prompts for Visual Recognition with Missing Modalities
papers.evidence: 缺失模态下用于视觉识别的潜在提示学习
papers.tldr: 大规模多模态模型在模态缺失时性能陡降，现有基于实例特征的动态提示因特征不可靠而不稳定。本文提出从可靠潜在提示学习的新范式，将可学习提示建模为与输入无关的稳定潜在锚点，实现鲁棒引导与跨模态知识补偿。在三个基准数据集上，该方法在宽泛缺失率下均达最优性能，甚至应对90%极端缺失。该范式为缺失模态问题提供了鲁棒解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale multimodal models (LMMs) have achieved superior performance in visual recognition by synergizing information across diverse, massive-scale paired modalities. In real-world scenarios, however, missing-modality inputs are ubiquitous, causing models optimized for modality-complete data to exhibit precipitous performance degradation. Existing research has introduced prompt learning to mitigate this issue, typically by generating dynamic prompts from instance-level features, regardless of whether the input modalities are complete or partially absent. However, such input-conditioned strategies are hindered by the escalating unreliability of instance-level features; as higher missing rates increase the proportion of incomplete modalities, the resulting instability in prompt learning limits the model's performance. To address this limitation, we hypothesize that learnable latent prompts themselves encapsulate stable, modality-intrinsic priors that are decoupled from corrupted inputs. Consequently, we propose a novel paradigm: Learning from Reliable Latent Prompts. Unlike prior methods, we model input-agnostic learnable prompts as stable latent anchors that enable robust guidance and effective cross-modal knowledge compensation, even under extreme missing rates (e.g., 90%). Empirical results across three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our "learn-from-latent-prompts" approach achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of missing-modality scenarios. Extensive experiments further confirm the effectiveness of this paradigm in providing a robust solution to the missing-modality problem.

papers.title_en: A Taxonomy of Single-Turn Textual Prompt Patterns
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的30种单轮文本提示模式分类法
papers.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）的提示工程中，提示模式（prompt pattern）的定义和分类尚不统一。本文采用可重复方法，系统梳理了单轮文本交互场景下的规范提示模式。最终提出一个包含30种独特模式、沿两个维度组织的分类法，为提示设计提供结构化参考，有助于提升LLM交互的规范性与有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are now widely employed in software development and everyday use. Interacting with LLMs requires crafting prompts, which range from simple ad hoc sentences to extensive, detailed, and structured instructions. Knowledge about prompt engineering has been documented in several surveys and catalogs in the literature. However, the term ``prompt pattern'' is defined differently across sources, and existing works have classified prompt patterns in different ways. In this report, we present a taxonomy of prompt patterns for single-turn, text-based interactions. Following a reproducible method, we identified 30 unique and canonical prompt patterns, organized along two dimensions.

papers.title_en: BT-APE: A Computationally Light Backtracking Approach to Automatic Prompt Engineering for Requirements Classification
papers.authors: Mohammad Amin Zadenoori, Waad Alhoshan, Jacek Dąbrowski, Liping Zhao, Alessio Ferrari
papers.evidence: 通过迭代优化自动提示工程
papers.tldr: LLMs在需求工程中应用广泛，但手工设计提示耗时长且效果不一致，自动提示工程（APE）在该领域未被充分探索。BT-APE将提示设计视为优化问题，通过LLM生成候选、回溯搜索和动态示例选择迭代精化提示。在三个基准数据集和五个指令微调LLM上，BT-APE与资源密集型PE2方法准确率几乎相同，均大幅优于经典基线，且BT-APE的计算开销显著更低（输入Token减少约72%，时间缩短66%）。该轻量级框架为资源受限环境提供了可行方案，并首次在需求分类中系统对比了APE与经典提示。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to requirements engineering (RE) tasks, yet the prompts guiding them are typically designed manually through trial and error, yielding inconsistent and suboptimal results. Automated prompt construction remains largely unexplored in RE, leaving its effectiveness unclear. To address this, we propose a lightweight Automatic Prompt Engineering approach, Backtracking APE (BT-APE), and apply it to requirements classification. We frame prompt design as an optimization problem, iteratively refining prompts via LLM-generated candidates, backtracking search, and dynamic example selection. Evaluating BT-APE on three benchmark datasets with five instruction-tuned LLMs, we compare it against four classical prompting baselines (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, CoT+few-shot) and a state-of-the-art but resource-intensive APE baseline (PE2). BT-APE and PE2 achieve nearly identical accuracy, both substantially outperforming the classical baselines with large effect sizes; however, BT-APE imposes a far lighter computational footprint, consuming roughly 72% fewer input tokens and 66% less wall-clock time at equivalent accuracy, making it better suited to resource-constrained deployment. Our contributions are threefold: (i) a lightweight APE framework with an open interactive tool and replication package; (ii) the first systematic comparison of APE against classical prompting for requirements classification; and (iii) insights into how class definitions and prompt evolution affect performance.

papers.title_en: AdaBoosting Text Prompts for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Seokhee Jin, Changhwan Sung, Sunung Mun, Hoyoung Kim, Jungseul Ok
papers.evidence: 通过AdaBoost优化离散文本提示用于少样本分类
papers.tldr: 预训练视觉语言模型（VLMs）的分类准确率高度依赖文本提示的质量，但现有少样本提示方法在构建时未明确关注误分类样本，导致即便增加标注数据，性能提升也有限。受AdaBoost启发，本文提出文本提示增强（TPB）框架，将每个基于文本提示的分类器视为弱学习器，并通过顺序聚合显式针对难分示例来构建强集成。在十一项分类基准上，TPB在源模型上提升准确率，并在迁移至更大VLM时仍能维持随样本增加带来的增益，而现有方法难以做到。TPB在文本空间保存了任务内在的、模型无关的线索，实现鲁棒的跨模型迁移，为少样本提示学习提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: The classification accuracy of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) relies on the quality of the text prompts. Handcrafted templates and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated descriptions not only make predictions more interpretable, but also enable reuse of the same prompts across heterogeneous VLMs. Recent works construct task-adapted text prompts with a small number of labeled images. However, existing few-shot text prompting methods do not explicitly focus on misclassified examples during prompt construction, leading to only marginal improvements even as more shots become available. To fully exploit few-shot supervision, we propose Text Prompt Boosting (TPB), an AdaBoost-inspired framework that treats each text-prompt-based classifier as a weak learner and sequentially aggregates them into a strong ensemble by explicitly targeting hard, misclassified examples. Extensive experiments show that TPB preserves task-intrinsic, model-agnostic cues in text space, enabling robust cross-model transfer. Across eleven classification benchmarks, TPB improves accuracy on the source model and preserves shot-driven gains when transferred to larger, more capable VLMs, where existing methods struggle to sustain such improvements.

papers.title_en: Reproducing FACTER: Fairness via Conformal Thresholding and Prompt Repair
papers.authors: Oscar Miró López-Feliu, Daimy van Loo, Xanthos Kekkos, Mikel Blom, Clara Rus
papers.evidence: 复现使用迭代提示修复的框架，一种自动提示优化技术
papers.tldr: 最近提出的FACTER框架旨在通过共形阈值与提示修复实现推荐系统的公平性与统计覆盖。本文对其进行再现研究，涵盖开放生成和受限重排序任务。严格再现下发现推荐效用分歧，归因于原评估目标集定义不明确。在受限重排序中引入静态公平基线，表明FACTER减少自适应阈值违反，但全局公平性未提升。研究发现静态公平指令可达到与动态修复相当的语义对等，提示在线修复机制效益有限。代码已公开。
papers.abstract_en: Fayyazi et al. (2025) recently proposed FACTER, a model-agnostic framework designed to jointly enforce fairness and statistical coverage in LLM-based recommendation through conformal thresholding and iterative prompt repair. In this work, we conduct a reproducibility study of the FACTER framework across diverse architectures and dataset sparsity levels, evaluating both the original open-ended generation task and a constrained re-ranking extension. Under the strict reproduction, we observe a divergence in recommendation utility, which we trace to underspecified target-set evaluation in the original study. We then use the constrained re-ranking setting to evaluate FACTER when the candidate set is fixed, and introduce a static Fair Zero-Shot baseline to isolate the contribution of the iterative prompt repair loop. Our analysis shows that FACTER consistently reduces adaptive-threshold violation counts, but that these reductions are not consistently reflected under the fixed threshold or in global fairness metrics. In the constrained ranking setting, static fairness instructions achieve comparable semantic-parity outcomes to FACTER's dynamic repair loop, suggesting that the additional online repair mechanism provides limited benefit in this formulation. All code and reproduction artifacts are available at https://github.com/oscar-omlf/facter-repr.
